# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi

"""Commit compact layer-major qualification and retire closed duplicate logs."""
from pathlib import Path
import fcntl
import importlib.util
import json
import re

B = Path('/home/yayoi/.local/state/strata-sycl/post-reboot-tuning-20261007')
G = Path('/home/yayoi/ghq/github.com/yqYo1/Strata/.worktree')
W = G / 'feat-layer-major-bulk-upload-20261013'
K = G / 'feat-layer-major-phase4k-20261013'
F = W / 'bench/results/2026-10-13-layer-major-bulk-upload'
O = B / 'xe-llvm-v711-source-v5/direct_owner.py'
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('layer_publication_owner', O)
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(m)
assert m.sha(O) == 'a29d8257eecc77c4ad9ae6671d092b56f4c09a35c4247c125fed3a8c8bc1f95f'


def load(path):
    return json.loads(Path(path).read_text())


def safe(value, key=''):
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {k: safe(v, k) for k, v in value.items()}
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [safe(v) for v in value]
    if isinstance(value, str) and key != 'sha256' and re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{64}', value):
        return dict(sha256=value)
    return value


def dump(path, value):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text(json.dumps(safe(value), ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + '\n')


with (B / 'owned-v0141-measurement.lock').open('a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX | fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    names = ['main-layer-major-bulk-full-build-root-v1','main-layer-major-bulk-full-build-root-v2',
        'main-layer-major-bulk-full-lints-root-v1','main-layer-major-bulk-full-lints-root-v2',
        'main-layer-major-bulk-full-lints-root-v3','main-layer-major-bulk-small-upload-root-v1',
        'main-layer-major-bulk-prefix32k-first-row-root-v1']
    receipts={name:load(B/name/'record.json') for name in names}
    assert all(not d['active'] and all(m.closed(c) for c in d.get('commands',[])) for d in receipts.values())
    build,lint,actual=receipts[names[1]],receipts[names[4]],receipts[names[6]]
    assert all(d['passed'] and d['complete'] for d in (build,lint,actual,receipts[names[5]]))
    assert lint['lints_qualified'] and not lint['novel_findings']
    assert build['source_pins']==lint['source_pins']==actual['source_pins']
    build_original_source_pins=dict(build['source_pins'])
    assert receipts[names[5]]['actual_small_bulk_qualified']
    assert actual['actual_bulk_all_layers_qualified'] and actual['exact_first_rows_equal']
    assert actual['binary_sha256']==build['free']['binary_sha256']
    assert all(m.sha(W/name)==sha for name,sha in build['source_pins'].items())
    out = B / 'main-layer-major-bulk-publication-root-v1'
    assert not out.exists() and not F.exists()
    out.mkdir()
    r = dict(active=True, passed=False, complete=False, commands=[], evidence={}, main_reviewed=True,
             source_pins=build['source_pins'], gpu_executed=False, adopted=False, performance_samples=[])

    def save():
        (out / 'record.json').write_text(json.dumps(r, indent=2) + '\n')

    owner = m.Owner(out / 'commands', save)
    r['commands'] = owner.commands
    env = dict(build['environment'], GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT='0', GIT_SSH_COMMAND='ssh -oBatchMode=yes')

    def run(label, argv, allowed=(0,)):
        print('LAYER PUBLICATION ' + label, flush=True)
        c, so, se = owner.run(label, argv, env, W, wall=300, cpu=1800,
                            rss_cap=2 << 30, text_cap=8 << 20, total_cap=32 << 20)
        r['evidence'][label] = dict(stdout=so.read_text(), stderr=se.read_text())
        save()
        assert m.closed(c) and c['session_anchored'] and c['exit_code'] in allowed, label
        return so.read_text().strip()

    try:
        assert run('head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD']) == '8b48d17c99b70d32781f9f5b056602a598a37b1c'
        assert not run('local-identity', ['git', 'config', '--local', '--get-regexp', r'^user\.(name|email)$'], (1,))
        run('author-identity', ['git', 'var', 'GIT_AUTHOR_IDENT'])
        dirty = run('dirty', ['git', 'diff', '--name-only']).splitlines()
        new = run('new', ['git', 'ls-files', '--others', '--exclude-standard']).splitlines()
        assert set(dirty + new) == set(build['source_pins'])
        F.mkdir()
        compact_paths = {}
        deletion_candidates = []
        for name, original in receipts.items():
            path = B / name / 'record.json'
            compact = {k: v for k, v in original.items() if k != 'evidence'}
            compact['evidence_policy'] = 'Full successful text/source listings retired after verified structured results; command/log identity, ownership, findings and original failure status retained.'
            compact['original_receipt'] = dict(path=str(path), sha256=m.sha(path), bytes=path.stat().st_size,
                consumer='Current phase qualification controllers pin these immutable receipts; retire original only after consumers move to compact evidence')
            if name.endswith('build-root-v1'):
                evidence = original['evidence'].get('build-free', {})
                compact['failure_excerpt'] = '\n'.join(line for line in (evidence.get('stdout', '') + '\n' + evidence.get('stderr', '')).splitlines()
                    if re.search(r'error:|sign-compare|1453|Werror|ninja: build stopped', line))[:8192]
            if name==names[6]:
                compact['health_outputs'] = {label: '\n'.join(line for line in original['evidence'][label]['stdout'].splitlines()
                    if line.startswith(('PASS ', 'LIBRARY '))) for label in ('health-before', 'health-after')}
            target = F / 'receipts' / (name + '.json')
            dump(target, compact)
            assert load(target)['passed'] == original['passed'] and load(target)['complete'] == original['complete']
            compact_paths[name] = target
            for command in original.get('commands',[]):
                for log_name, identity in command['logs'].items():
                    raw = B / name / 'commands' / log_name
                    if raw.is_file():
                        assert raw.stat().st_size == identity['bytes'] and m.sha(raw) == identity['sha256']
                        deletion_candidates.append(dict(path=str(raw), bytes=identity['bytes'], sha256=identity['sha256'],
                            replacement=str(target), replacement_sha256=m.sha(target), reason='Closed duplicate raw text; command status/identity, relevant findings, exact requests/admissions/layer rows and health/fault outcomes retained'))
        controllers=['main-layer-major-bulk-full-build-v1.py','main-layer-major-bulk-full-build-v2.py',
            'main-layer-major-bulk-full-lints-v1.py','main-layer-major-bulk-full-lints-v2.py',
            'main-layer-major-bulk-full-lints-v3.py','main-layer-major-bulk-small-upload-v1.py',
            'main-layer-major-bulk-prefix32k-first-row-v1.py']
        for name in controllers:
            path=B/name
            dump(F/'controllers'/(name+'.json'),dict(path=str(path),sha256=m.sha(path),text=path.read_text()))
        prior_path=K/'bench/results/2026-10-13-layer-major-phase4k-stock-bench/report-registry-v198.json'
        prior=load(prior_path)
        assert prior['research_completed']==1001
        dump(F/'report-registry-v199.json',dict(research_completed=1001,prior=dict(path=str(prior_path),sha256=m.sha(prior_path)),
            new_reports=[],main_only_test_execution=True,
            main_corrections='CMake fixture missing strata_engine linkage; private mode flag placement; preserved failed controller newline comparison and11 NoNew findings. Source fixed checked segmented lcm/rounding bounds, actual active array extent, fixture widening/side-effect sequencing, doc blank lines.17 unchanged checks reused; allfive corrected files rechecked against actual qualified baseline. No suppressions or inference math changes.'))
        summary=dict(source_revision=actual['source_revision'],source_uncommitted_candidate=True,
            source_pins=actual['source_pins'],binary_sha256=actual['binary_sha256'],build_modes=['free','contrib-llvm'],
            full_builds_pass=True,host_ctest_four_configurations_pass=True,host_asan_ubsan_pass=True,
            server_phase_lifetime_pass=True,actual_parent_no_new_lints_pass=True,actual_small_bulk_both_modes_pass=True,
            actual_model_bulk_pass=True,bulk_upload_summaries=actual['bulk_upload_summaries'],
            maximum_actual_layer_copy_bytes=actual['maximum_actual_layer_copy_bytes'],
            exact_first_rows_equal=actual['exact_first_rows_equal'],numerical_pair=actual['paired_first_rows'],
            requests=actual['requests'],admissions=actual['actual_admissions'],actual_layer_rows=actual['actual_layer_rows'],
            actual_gated_layouts=actual['actual_gated_layouts'],normal_quit=actual['normal_quit'],
            kernel_checks=actual['kernel_checks'],boot_id=actual['boot_id'],prompt_diagnostic_spans=actual['prompt_diagnostic_spans'],
            exposed_upload_scope='Source access and checked synchronous copy wrapper; not purePCIe or official TPS',
            default_off=True,adopted=False,model_quality_qualified=False,full_physical262144_qualified=False,restore_qualified=False,
            stock_benchmark_executed=False,performance_samples=[],research_completed=1001,
            skill_scope='Current project skill97f8 is project-only; carry root-to-project relocation before adoption',
            next_step='Unchanged upstream bench.sh debug closure and matched quiet3runs against qualified4K per-expert copy. Full262144/RESTORE and decode critical-path qualification remain required')
        dump(F/'summary.json',summary)
        dump(F / 'deletion-manifest.json', dict(policy='docs/ARTIFACT_RETENTION.md in user workspace',
            serialized=True, active_runs_touched=False, original_failed_status_preserved=True,
            original_pinned_receipts_retained_for_current_consumers=True, entries=deletion_candidates,
            logical_bytes=sum(entry['bytes'] for entry in deletion_candidates), physical_free_space_claim=False))
        ja = '<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->\n<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->\n# レイヤー単位一括expert転送の実機検証\n\n既定OFFの一括転送を、free/contrib-llvmのビルド、4構成CPU・ASan/UBSan、サーバーlifetime、静的検査で確認。\n実GPUの小試験は両モードで全512expert、7幅、物理容量、条件不成立時の個別コピーを確認した。\n実モデルfresh GEN1024/32768は全48層のowned Host-USM転送を各1回で完了し、正常QUIT。\n各GENの論理payload50292326400 bytes、コピー48回、fallback0、最大1回1363148800 bytes。\n従来4K処理の同一固定履歴2位置で全248320 FP32logitをバイト比較し一致。\nこれは2位置の証拠で、能力全体・全256K・RESTORE・速度の合格ではない。\n\n初回検査の改行比較ミスと次の11静的指摘は失敗のまま保存。\nMainは桁あふれとゼロを防ぐcacheサイズ計算、実配列長でのoffset書込み、テスト型・副作用順序・docs空行を修正。\n修正後の全ビルド・CPU検査と5ファイル再検査を通過。残る17不変ファイルの完了済検査を再利用し、抑制なし。\n前後model hash、同一boot/provider、GPU health、無障害を確認。転送wallはPCIe単独の時間ではない。\n次は変更しない公式bench.shのdebug経路閉鎖とquiet3回比較。正式採用は保留。\n'
        en = '<!-- SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 yayoi -->\n<!-- SPDX-License-Identifier: LGPL-3.0-or-later -->\n# Actual layer-major bulk expert upload qualification\n\nDefault-OFF bulk upload passed free/contrib-llvm builds,four CPU/ASan/UBSan configurations,server lifetime and static checks.\nReal small GPU tests in both modes verified all512 experts,seven widths,physical accounting and declined-layout per-expert fallback.\nActual fresh GEN1024/32768 completed one owned Host-USM copy per each of48 layers followed by normal QUIT.\nEach GEN copied50292326400 logical bytes in48 calls,zero fallback; largest single copy1363148800 bytes.\nAll248320 FP32 logits matched the old4K path byte for byte at two fixed-history positions.\nThis is two-position evidence,not whole-model capability,full256K,RESTORE or speed qualification.\n\nThe initial controller newline-comparison failure and subsequent11 static findings retain failed status.\nMain corrected zero/overflow-safe cache sizing,active-array extent,fixture widening/side-effect sequencing and doc blank lines.\nFull rebuild/CPU tests and fresh all-tool checks on five corrected files passed; completed checks on17 unchanged files were reused without suppressions.\nPre/post model hashes,same boot/providers,GPU health and fault checks passed. Copy wall spans are not purePCIe time.\nNext: unchanged official bench.sh debug closure and matched quiet3runs. Adoption remains pending.\n'
        (F / 'README.ja.md').write_text(ja)
        (F / 'README.md').write_text(en)
        dump(F / 'controllers/main-layer-major-bulk-publication-v1.py.json', dict(path=__file__, sha256=m.sha(__file__), text=Path(__file__).read_text()))
        files = sorted(str(path.relative_to(W)) for path in F.rglob('*') if path.is_file())
        output = run('report-lints', ['/bin/bash', 'tools/lint/run.sh', *files])
        assert 'skipped (' not in output and '== gitleaks: a possible secret' not in output
        run('diff-check', ['git', 'diff', '--check'])
        for entry in deletion_candidates:
            raw = Path(entry['path'])
            assert raw.stat().st_size == entry['bytes'] and m.sha(raw) == entry['sha256']
            assert m.sha(entry['replacement']) == entry['replacement_sha256']
        for entry in deletion_candidates:
            Path(entry['path']).unlink()
        r['deleted_files'] = len(deletion_candidates)
        r['deleted_logical_bytes'] = sum(entry['bytes'] for entry in deletion_candidates)
        run('stage', ['git', 'add', '--', *build['source_pins'], str(F.relative_to(W))])
        run('commit', ['git', 'commit', '-m', 'Qualify checked layer-major bulk upload with exact logits and guarded cache extents'])
        r['commit'] = run('committed-head', ['git', 'rev-parse', 'HEAD'])
        run('push', ['git', 'push', '-u', 'origin', 'HEAD'])
        assert not run('final-status', ['git', 'status', '--porcelain', '--untracked-files=all'])
        r.update(passed=True, complete=True, research_completed=1001)
    except BaseException as error:
        import traceback
        r['error'] = repr(error)
        r['traceback']=traceback.format_exc()
    finally:
        r.update(active=owner.active is not None, finished_utc=m.utc())
        save()
    print(json.dumps({k: r.get(k) for k in ('passed', 'error', 'commit', 'deleted_files', 'deleted_logical_bytes')}))
    raise SystemExit(0 if r['passed'] else 1)
